text: APPROVE. The per-file loop body moves into `UnusedWriteScopeGrantsInFile` and `UnusedTopLevelGrants` with the same ordering and early exits, and the iterator is consumed immediately by `AddRange`, so behaviour is unchanged. Each of the three methods scores well under 15 by my count (about 10 at most), and I see nothing that would break the build, including definite assignment of `top`. I judged this from the diff alone, without building or running tests.
